name: Job Board Manager – Recruit & Hire
author: Salman Khan

sections.description:
Job Board Manager is a straightforward tool designed to help you list job openings on your website with ease. Whether you are running a company career page, a local community board, or a niche job portal, this plugin provides the essential foundation you need without the bloat.

We built this plugin to be human-friendly. You don’t need to be a developer to get it running. Simply install, add your job details, and use a shortcode to display the board anywhere on your site. It is designed to be clean, fast, and SEO-friendly, helping your job postings get indexed by search engines.

Upgrade To Pro – Job Board Pro

Check Free Version Demo

Watch the complete video tutorial below:

Why use Job Board Manager?
It focuses on what matters: getting your jobs online. We have removed unnecessary complexity so you can focus on hiring. It works with any theme and allows for standard job data like salary, location, and company information.

Free Features

  • Simple Job Management: Add, edit, and organize job postings just like standard WordPress posts.
  • Instant Shortcode: Display your job board on any page or widget area using [wfojb_job_board].
  • Search & Filtering: Includes a built-in search bar so candidates can easily find relevant positions.
  • Detailed Job Views: specific fields for Salary, Job Type (Full-time, Part-time, etc.), City, and Company Name.
  • External Applications: Direct applicants to an external website or email address for the application process.
  • Job Categories: Organize your listings by industry, department, or location.
  • Responsive Design: Looks great on mobiles, tablets, and desktops.
  • Company Branding: Upload company logos to make listings pop.

Pro Features (Upgrade to Pro)

Take your job board to the next level with automation and premium designs:

  • Internal Application System: Allow candidates to apply directly on your site with a CV upload form.
  • Applicant Dashboard: View, manage, and track applications directly from your WordPress admin.
  • Premium Templates: Access exclusive layouts like “The Notion” and “Hero Visual” for a professional look.
  • Grid Layout: Display jobs in a modern, space-saving grid format.
  • Google reCAPTCHA: Prevent spam applications on your forms.
  • Analytics: Track how many people are viewing your jobs.
  • Import / Export: Bulk import jobs via CSV or export your data for reporting.
  • Waitlist: Capture candidate interest even when you don’t have open roles.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/online-job-board directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Job Board” menu to add your first job.
  4. Create a new page (e.g., “Careers”) and add the shortcode [wfojb_job_board] to display the list.
sections.faq:
How do I display the job board on my site?

After adding some jobs, simply create a new page or post and insert the shortcode [wfojb_job_board]. The job list will appear automatically.

Can I change the “Apply” button link?

Yes, in the Free version, you can set a “Button URL” for each job. This can link to an external application form, a Google Form, or a mailto: email address.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, Job Board Manager is designed to inherit styles from your active WordPress theme, ensuring it blends in perfectly.

Where can I see the applications?

In the Free version, applications are handled externally (via the link you provide). If you need to accept CVs and manage applications within WordPress, check out the Pro version.

How do I get the Pro version?

You can upgrade to the Pro version to unlock internal applications, analytics, and premium templates. Visit our website for more details.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • Security: Implemented “late escaping” across the entire plugin using esc_html, esc_attr, and esc_url.
  • Security: Switched to wp_json_encode for secure LD+JSON schema output.
  • Security: Added current_user_can and wp_verify_nonce protection to all AJAX handlers.
  • Compliance: Removed all “trialware” triggers, including the AJAX handler for restricted features.
  • Compliance: Deleted frontend-submission.php and removed the [wfojb_post_job] shortcode.
  • Compliance: Removed all restricted features (Internal Application, Pro Layouts) from the backend UI.
  • Security: Properly enqueued all assets; removed Bootstrap dependency and all inline styles/scripts.
  • UI/UX: Consolidated all plugin settings into a modern, AJAX-powered management interface.
  • UI/UX: Redesigned the “Go Pro” informational page with a clean, guideline-compliant comparison table.
  • Code Quality: Updated DataTables to v2.3.7 for better security and stability.
  • Cleanup: Purged over 500 lines of unused legacy code and misleading Pro-version teasers.
  • Compatibility: Formally tested and updated compatibility for WordPress 6.4.

1.2.3

  • Security: Implemented late escaping for all outputs for enhanced security.
  • Security: Switched to wp_json_encode for LD+JSON schema.
  • Compliance: Removed Pro-only menus and backend logic (Analytics, Applicants, Import / Export, Waitlist) to comply with WordPress Plugin Guidelines.
  • Code Quality: Refactored enqueuing system; removed all inline styles and scripts.
  • Performance: Centralized admin asset management.
  • Bug Fix: Resolved duplicate menu registration issue.
  • Compatibility: Formally tested up to WordPress 6.9.

1.2.2

  • Added a dedicated “Go Pro” informational page
  • Fixed PHPCS Warning
  • Improved compatibility with WordPress 6.9.
  • Fixed duplicate menu registrations.
  • Updated “Tested up to” version.

1.2.1

  • Reworked on whole plugin added new features and fixed bugs
  • Improved compatibility with WordPress 6.9.1.

1.2.0

  • Initial stable release.
